context.description: The list of artifacts to also consider as the current context when validating dependencies. The "name", "kind", and "semanticVersion" fields must be populated.

scope.description:
The scope to ensure the existence of all dependencies listed in `resolvedDependencies` of the source artifacts.
- 'INPUT' scope will ensure dependencies exist in the input (`source`, `context`) artifacts.
- 'LOCAL' scope will ensure dependencies exist in the input (`source`, `context`) artifacts or in the local artifact hub.
- 'UPSTREAM' scope will ensure dependencies exist in the input (`source`, `context`) artifacts or in the upstream artifact hub (note that it will NOT include LOCAL).
- 'ALL' scope will ensure dependencies exist in the input (`source`, `context`) artifacts, local artifact hub, or upstream artifact hub.

validationLevel.description:
The level of validation to perform when checking the presence of `resolvedDependencies` within the `source` artifacts.
- 'NAME' level will only validate that artifacts with the same name exist in the specified scope.
- 'NAME_AND_VERSION' level will validate that an artifact with the same name and semantic version exists in the specified scope.

validationKinds.description: The kinds of artifacts to consider when validating the artifacts. If empty, all kinds are considered.

upstreamHub.description: Only applicable if `scope` is 'UPSTREAM' or 'ALL'. The name of the upstream artifact hub to check for dependencies. If not specified, will use the default upstream hub.

title: Specification for validating the dependencies of a set of artifacts.
name: ArtifactHub.Artifact.DependencyValidationSpec
